objective: Provide project-stage announcements that project members maintain and the project overview displays for stages active on the current date.
users: Project members reading and maintaining their project's stage announcements.

requirements.statement: Add a project-detail announcement-management tab while preserving existing tab routes.
acceptance: Direct and interactive tab navigation open announcement management.

requirements.statement: Persist project-owned announcements with a stage, title, rich-text content and pin flag.
acceptance: Member CRUD and pinning survive refresh.
counterexample: Reusing test-management announcements or writing release-window data.

requirements.statement: Authorize project members on the server for announcement reads and writes.
acceptance: Non-members, cross-tenant callers and invalid project-stage writes are denied.

requirements.statement: Show only announcements for stages whose top-level project plans contain the current date, including parallel stages.
acceptance: Pinned entries sort first and no-stage states are explicit.
counterexample: Showing historical or future-stage announcements as current.

requirements.statement: Render safe rich-text summaries in a responsive overview announcement panel.
acceptance: Required desktop and mobile viewports have no page-level overflow and unsafe markup cannot execute.
counterexample: Raw untrusted HTML or a desktop-only announcement panel.

requirements.statement: Maintain release-calendar records with stable color-family keys and render their date boxes from the active system theme.
acceptance: Maintenance offers only five swatch-led internal color families, without global-palette or semantic-color names.
A saved color family remains after refresh.
Existing and newly saved entries update their date-box background and border when the global theme palette or light/dark appearance changes.
counterexample: Offering global palette schemes such as ocean or tech-blue as a release-calendar selection.
Keeping a stale fixed color after a theme change.

invariants: Server-side tenant, membership, entity, stage, optimistic-lock and audit controls apply.
constraints: Vue 3 and existing Element Plus/UI patterns.
Project system module owns API and data.
Reuse active global theme CSS variables without a new field or Flyway migration.

selected_approach.name: Project-owned stage announcements
selected_approach.reason: Keeps stage selection, member authorization, overview rendering and persistence within the project boundary.

alternatives.name: Reuse test-management announcements
alternatives.rejected_because: It crosses business data ownership and authorization boundaries.

alternatives.name: Reuse station messages
alternatives.rejected_because: It cannot model stage-owned maintenance and overview ordering.

inside: Project release-calendar color-family maintenance and rendering

components.name: ProjectView
components.responsibility: Tab routing, management interaction, responsive overview panel and active-theme color-family release date rendering

components.name: ProjectService
components.responsibility: Project-scoped CRUD, release-calendar color-family validation, stage calculation, authorization and audit

interfaces.name: Project announcement REST API
interfaces.contract: Project-scoped management CRUD and current-stage overview read with optimistic locking.

interfaces.name: Project release-calendar API
interfaces.contract: Keeps the existing theme_key field; new writes accept stable tone-1 through tone-5 keys and reads retain legacy values.

data_flows.input: Project member chooses an active-theme color family while saving a release-calendar entry
transitions: Server validates the stable color-family key and persists theme_key
Overview maps the key to an active global theme CSS token
Global palette and appearance changes update the rendered CSS token without changing the record
data_flows.output: A persisted release date with a theme-responsive calendar box.

error_handling.recovery: Maintain announcements in the management tab.

error_handling.behavior: Deny on server and show no-permission or validation feedback

security: Server-side membership, tenant, entity and stage checks
compatibility: Preserve existing project tabs and plan behavior
operations: Additive migration and retained records on rollback

verification_strategy.signal: Tabs and overview remain responsive and safe
verification_strategy.method: Browser regression at desktop and mobile.

verification_strategy.signal: Persisted CRUD, audit and denied unauthorized writes
Current and parallel stages filter and order announcements
verification_strategy.method: Focused service/API tests and browser checks.

verification_strategy.signal: Only theme-internal color families are selectable and both new and legacy date boxes react to active palette and appearance changes.
verification_strategy.method: Focused service validation plus browser checks across two global palettes in light and dark appearance.

assumptions.text: Top-level project-plan dates and phases represent current implementation stages.
assumptions.basis: User stated the current stage is determined by current date.
assumptions.falsifier: A project requires manually declared or non-plan stage dates.

decisions.decision: All project members can create, edit and delete announcements.
Use title, rich-text content, stage and pin flag.
Display all parallel current stages and sort by pin, stage and publication time.
Use a three-panel desktop overview with a compact project summary, current-stage announcements and a current-year release calendar; place the project schedule on its own row.
decisions.reason: Keeps the overview compact while showing release dates from existing project calendar data.

decisions.decision: The overview release calendar defaults to the current month, only navigates within the current year and marks release dates with a color dot only.

Offer five swatch-led color families from the active global theme for new release-calendar entries; render saved tone keys with active palette and light/dark variants, and map prior keys to tone-1 for compatibility.
decisions.reason: User clarified that the selection must be a theme-internal color family rather than a global theme palette or semantic color choice.

risks.mitigation: Sanitize before storage and rendering with targeted tests.
Test date boundaries, no-stage and parallel-stage cases.

approval.evidence: User reviewed and confirmed design revision 4: theme-internal color families change with the active global theme.
